sn47.24:1.1: Sāvatthinidānam || || Cattāro me bhikkhave satipaṭṭhānā || katame cattāro || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati || ātāpi sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || Vedanāsu || Citte || Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro satipaṭṭhānā ti || ||
